How to tell them apart?updated Sep 2020

Several different kinds of small fishes are silvery. Here’s more on how to tell them apart.


Kops’ glass perchelet
(Ambassis kopsii)
Family Ambassidae
Mojarra
Family Gerreidae
    Dorsal fin deeply notched, with blackish tip. Dorsal fin single continunous (not notched) with blackish tip.
